title: Protect PDF: AES-256 encryption, permissions, remove protection on real documents
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-security; O-04 (set, change and remove protection; saved file honours permissions) and A-30 (Protect PDF) work on real documents
notes: Library half of the protect pair per ADR 0012. Serves acceptance items O-04 (set/change/remove password and permissions; a saved file keeps encryption and honours permissions) and A-30 (Protect PDF: password and permissions, redact and sanitize entry points) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Writes AES-256 encryption with owner/user passwords and permission bits, changes and removes protection through the pdfxi-document session of ADR 0010 (which currently refuses to save encrypted sessions with EncryptedSaveUnsupported), and proves it by reopening the saved file with PDFium and with an independent decrypt check. A serialised app shell task follows once this lands; matrix rows stay `library` until that shell task verifies them.
